mapper.select: SELECT dev_id AS "id",mng_no AS "managementNo",dev_nm AS "name",emp_type_cd AS "employeeType",drct_cls_cd AS "directClass",jbps_cd AS "position" FROM tb_hr_dev ORDER BY dev_id

SELECT c.code,c.code_val AS "value" FROM tb_sy_code c JOIN tb_sy_code_grp g ON g.code_grp_id=c.code_grp_id WHERE c.code_grp_id='ALWNC' AND c.use_yn='Y' AND c.del_yn='N' AND g.use_yn='Y' AND c.code IN ('ALLOW_TEAM','ALLOW_GROUP','SEV_RATE','INS_RATE') ORDER BY c.code FOR SHARE OF c,g

SELECT dev_id AS "developerId",pay_amt AS "pay",alwnc_amt AS "allowance",insr_cmpny_amt AS "companyInsurance",insr_self_amt AS "selfInsurance", retire_rsv_amt AS "retirement",incm_tax_amt AS "incomeTax",wthld_tax_amt AS "withholding",real_pay_amt AS "realPay",vndr_sply_amt AS "vendorSupply",emp_type_cd AS "employeeType",drct_cls_cd AS "directClass" FROM tb_hr_mon_pay WHERE pay_ym=#{month} ORDER BY pay_ym,dev_id
SELECT p.dev_id AS "developerId",d.mng_no AS "managementNo",d.dev_nm AS "developerName" FROM tb_hr_mon_pay p JOIN tb_hr_dev d ON d.dev_id=p.dev_id WHERE p.pay_ym=#{month} ORDER BY p.dev_id
SELECT lpad(trunc(std_val)::text,6,'0') FROM tb_sy_oper_std WHERE std_cd='CASH_BASE_YM' ORDER BY aply_bgn_ym DESC LIMIT 1 FOR SHARE
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM tb_cl_close WHERE close_ym=#{month} AND close_stat_cd='CLOSE')
mapper.update: LOCK TABLE tb_cl_close IN SHARE MODE
mapper.sql: upld_id AS "uploadId",form_type_cd AS "formType",scrn_id AS "screenId",file_nm AS "filename",file_size AS "size",trgt_ym AS "month",reg_user_id AS "actor",upld_stat_cd AS "status",tot_row_cnt AS "totalRows",succ_cnt AS "successRows",warn_cnt AS "warningRows",err_cnt AS "errorRows"
mapper.select: SELECT FROM tb_sy_upld WHERE upld_id=#{uploadId} FOR UPDATE

SELECT rslt_sn AS "sequence",rslt_type_cd AS "severity",row_no AS "rowNumber",coalesce(col_nm,'') AS "columnName",coalesce(input_val,'') AS "inputValue",rsn_cn AS "reason" FROM tb_sy_upld_err WHERE upld_id=#{uploadId} ORDER BY rslt_sn
SELECT chg_item_nm AS "item",aft_val AS "value" FROM tb_sy_chg_hist WHERE trgt_tbl_nm='TB_SY_UPLD' AND trgt_key=CAST(#{uploadId} AS text) AND chg_rsn=#{reason} ORDER BY hist_id
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_hr_mon_pay SET pay_amt=#{value.pay},alwnc_amt=#{value.allowance},insr_cmpny_amt=#{value.companyInsurance},insr_self_amt=#{value.selfInsurance},retire_rsv_amt=#{value.retirement},incm_tax_amt=#{value.incomeTax},wthld_tax_amt=#{value.withholding},real_pay_amt=#{value.realPay},vndr_sply_amt=#{value.vendorSupply},emp_type_cd=#{value.employeeType},drct_cls_cd=#{value.directClass},upld_id=#{uploadId},mod_user_id=#{actor},mod_dttm=#{now} WHERE pay_ym=#{month} AND dev_id=#{developerId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM tb_hr_mon_pay WHERE pay_ym=#{month} AND dev_id=#{developerId}
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_sy_upld SET upld_stat_cd='APPLIED',aply_dttm=#{now},mod_user_id=#{actor},mod_dttm=#{now} WHERE upld_id=#{uploadId} AND upld_stat_cd='CHECKED'
